description: This file contains utility functions and setup code for a FastAPI-based API service, including configuration handling, app import logic, and command-line argument parsing. It provides mechanisms to serve the OpenBB Platform API, manage its settings, and dynamically import app instances.

methods.name: check_port
methods.description: Checks if a network port is free on a given host, incrementing until an available port is found.

methods.name: get_user_settings
methods.description: Loads or updates user settings for the OpenBB platform, optionally connecting to a hub service to fetch credentials and preferences.

methods.name: get_widgets_json
methods.description: Generates or loads the 'widgets.json' configuration for the API, with options to build or merge with existing data.

methods.name: import_app
methods.description: Dynamically imports and returns a FastAPI app instance from a specified file or module, supporting both module paths and file paths, with optional factory creation.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for launching the API server, handling paths, app import, and configuration options.
